method.frame: event-study (NOT a strategy backtest: no positions, sizing or costs)

hypotheses.Dislocation: mean reversion: forward move opposite to the z-score sign
hypotheses.Momentum: continuation: forward move in the direction of the 50/200 spread
hypotheses.Correlation regime: persistence: ρ120 after 60 obs is closer to the new regime than the old

baselines.directional: per-episode P(same-sign move) from outcomes available strictly before entry after source lags; minimum 20 reference outcomes
baselines.corrPersistence: per-episode, same-pair monthly-stepped reference dates with identical entry delay/horizon; only outcomes available strictly before onset; minimum 20 reference outcomes

method.scope: daily price series only; yield/breakeven dislocations excluded from percent-return aggregation. Latest revised histories, not point-in-time vintages.
method.thresholds: unchanged production thresholds; no tuning during this methodology correction
method.ci: chronological moving-block bootstrap (block 5, B=1000, seeded); withheld for fewer than 20 episodes or all-hit/all-miss cuts; overlapping episodes/cross-asset dependence and multiple comparisons limit inference
method.publicationLags: FRED 3 calendar days; H.10 FX 10; Yahoo 1; then entry after 1 additional day. Conservative proxies, not historical release timestamps.
